name: Barclays PLC
blurb: Barclays PLC is a British multinational universal bank, headquartered in London. It operates in retail banking, credit cards, corporate and investment banking, and wealth management, with a strong presence in the UK, US, and Europe. As of early 2026, its market capitalization is approximately £61 billion, making it one of the largest banks in the UK.
